title: Records Basis — Counting the Plan Year on a Long-Standing Refined Fuels Account
content:
An account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts that has been on the books a long time does not always have its plan year counted over the same span as a newer one. How long the account has stood open, taken with whether the plan is still being billed, decides the span.

**Where the account has stood open longer than 3 years and an instalment was billed on it in the 3 months ending on the handling date**, the plan year is counted over the 14 months ending on the handling date.

**Where the account has stood open longer than 3 years and no instalment was billed on it in those 3 months**, the plan year is counted over the 13 months ending on the handling date.

**Where the account has stood open no longer than 3 years**, the plan year is counted over the 12 months ending on the handling date.

## The three spans at a glance

| Years the account has stood open | Instalment billed in the 3 months ending on the handling date | Months the plan year is counted over |
| --- | --- | --- |
| More than 3 | Yes, at least one | 14 |
| More than 3 | None | 13 |
| 3 or fewer | Either way | 12 |

The years an account has stood open are counted from the day it was opened to the handling date. The test is strict: an account standing open exactly 3 years has not stood open longer than 3 years, and its plan year is counted over 12 months.

*Hypothetical, at the boundary.* An account opened 3 years and one day before the handling date, with one instalment billed 2 months ago, has stood open longer than 3 years and carries an instalment inside the 3-month window, so its plan year is counted over 14 months. Had the most recent instalment been billed 4 months ago, the window would be 13 months. Had the account been opened 2 years and 11 months ago, the window would be 12 months whichever way the instalments fell.
